home.name: Alex Lyon
home.report: Lyon (upper body) had a setback in his recovery and is without a timeline to return, the team announced Thursday.

home.name: Matt Grzelcyk
home.report: Grzelcyk (lower body) suffered a "flare-up" and could be out for at least "a few days," head coach Lindy Ruff told Rachel Lenzi of The Buffalo News on Tuesday.

home.name: Jason Zucker
home.report: Zucker (abdomen) participated in Tuesday's morning skate but is still a few weeks away from returning to game action, Matthew Fairburn of The Athletic reports.

home.name: Conor Timmins
home.report: Timmins (lower body) doesn't have a timeline for his return yet, according to Heather Engel of NHL.com on Tuesday.

away.name: Owen Tippett
away.report: Tippett (upper body) will be a game-time decision against Ottawa on Saturday, per Jordan Hall of NBC Sports Philadelphia.

away.name: Rasmus Ristolainen
away.report: Ristolainen (upper body) won't travel with the Flyers ahead of Thursday's game against the Red Wings but is closing in on a return, Charlie O'Connor of PHLY Sports reports.

away.name: Travis Konecny
away.report: Konecny (lower body) was placed on injured reserve Sunday, according to the NHL media site.

away.name: Nikita Grebenkin
away.report: Grebenkin (back) underwent successful surgery and is expected to miss at least four months.
